content: Jirya̱tu̱chu Ju̱denujsa̱ nu̱dyeyadaju̱
Nu̱ñi̱tay ji̱ta tamitya, ratyeryi̱veda, jirya̱ntya tu̱chu sisa̱ Ju̱denu nu̱dyeyadaju̱, ra̱tidye ra̱y Ju̱denu niquejada, rirya̱jchana̱tya nijya̱nvay varirya nu̱tyu jiryi̱chana̱tyatiy jiryerya.
Jirya̱jachiñu̱y sivantiy, sa̱tidye jantyuy nu̱dyiva rirya̱jisiy taji jachipiya̱vay, va̱cha jvaavye jaryentiy, jiryi̱nu̱vyitya ne tuva̱chuvay ti̱ta̱ju̱ daryi.
Jto̱tanirya ji̱ta Vu̱ntyityu̱ day, ni̱day ra̱vanu̱tya jirye, sa̱jantyuy jiryiva, va̱cha jachipiya̱jada ja̱mi̱jisiy.
Nu̱dyetya ji̱ta Nutyityu̱mu jiryenchiy, jiryatiy jiryivaarya nu̱tyu̱choda, jirya̱jvaajeya̱sarantirya.
Sa̱ntya vasenu Nutyityu̱ra jiryejechiy, Ju̱denu va̱ta̱damuju̱, Crístu jachi̱dedamuju̱ntiy.
Vurye̱cha jvaavye

Nu̱ñi̱tay ji̱ta jiryiva, ratyeryi̱veda, Nutyityu̱ Jesucrístu jtyamu nu̱ñi̱tay: Jirya̱jiintye rirya̱jisiy vu̱tyeryi̱veda jiryatiy pituvyeryi, ne rityuva̱churu̱y variy ramu nu̱dyetyadoda jiryatiy jiryi̱mutya̱jada nu̱dyimusirya.

Jiryeñi ji̱ta datyara nu̱tyuramusiy jirya̱jantyara nu̱dyivaayada, nu̱tyuramu nu̱vyichanu̱yada ne pituvye jiryimu, dantyamu̱y ne nu̱ñi̱myiñu̱yada mityara ti̱ jmyi̱sara, nu̱tyu paru̱cha̱rityi nu̱dyivaañu̱yada nupora jarye, nu̱ryiñuma jiyasanta riy jiryetyevay.
Ne nu̱vyichasara jiryi̱myi̱sarata, nu̱tyu nusu̱byimiy nu̱ña̱vicha jiryimusiy, nu̱ña̱tidye barya jantyasara jiryejyu̱, jirya̱tidye jvaay daryantidye.
Nu̱ñi vicha̱danumatiy jiryisa̱ nu̱ñi̱teda variy jiryiva: Ni̱timyu̱ ne ra̱jvaay, ne sa̱jmyi.
Nu̱tyuva̱chuma̱ daryaju̱: Tavay rupiñumaya̱ jiryetyevay, pituvye, tama̱ ruvaaryu̱y, tama̱, mitya riityenumaya̱ ti̱sa̱ variyu.
Davyevyani̱ ji̱ta nu̱ñi̱tachara, nu̱dyeyasanta jarye risa̱ju̱ riy, Nutyityu̱ Jesucrístu jtyamu, rirya̱tidye jvaay samidye, rirya̱tidye jmyi varirya nu̱ñi jimyi̱sara day.
Jirye ji̱ta, ratyeryi̱veda, ne jirya̱paru̱y riva samirya jvaayada.
Ni̱timyu̱ ne tuva̱churu̱rya nu̱ñi̱teda caterava, jirya̱ntya jnu̱y mitya sana̱cho̱, jiryeñuma rupi sisa̱, sa̱tidye jada riva.
Ne jirya̱jnu̱y variy jamiryamusiy sana̱cho̱; jirya̱datyanu samirya vicha̱datani̱, ne jiryi̱nu̱y jityeryi̱ dañi̱.
Sa̱cha Ju̱denu jiryisa̱
Ni̱day ji̱ta jiryatiy samirya vicha̱da ja̱mi̱ni̱, sa̱ntya sa̱jeya̱sara jiryerya samirya vichasa̱da. Sa̱cha Nutyityu̱ jiryisa̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱.
Ramyu̱chuvay tamitya jirye, ray Pávuru. Rañu̱y rajyomututara. Ranuma rani̱cha rañu̱rya racyaterava.
Samirya ra̱cha ti̱ta̱ju̱ jiryejyu̱, Vu̱yntyityu̱ Jesucrístumusiy. Sayanuma jiryetyeryi̱ Pávuru
